image_description: A vintage black typewriter viewed from a high angle. The image focuses on the keyboard area, showing round white keys with black characters arranged in rows. At the bottom center is a long, rectangular key (the space bar) which is wider than the other keys but not spanning the full width of the carriage. The typewriter has a metallic frame and a paper roller mechanism at the top.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The metallic frame on the right side appears to melt or blend into the background/paper roller support. The geometry of the carriage return lever and the side bracket is ambiguous and lacks clear structural definition, suggesting AI generation artifacts in complex mechanical details.

The round keys lack distinct individual shadows or depth separation from the keyboard deck. They appear slightly 'painted on' or fused with the surface rather than being distinct physical objects sitting in holes. Some characters on the keys are indistinct or gibberish.

The cylindrical paper roller and the knobs on either end do not align perfectly with the perspective of the keyboard. The left knob seems to float or attach awkwardly, and the cylinder's curvature is inconsistent with the rest of the machine's geometry.
